result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would work to ensure that every person has access to quality education and the tools for critical thinking—not just literacy, but the ability to evaluate information, understand different perspectives, and engage thoughtfully with complex issues.  

Education has a ripple effect: it can reduce inequality, foster innovation, improve health outcomes, and build more compassionate communities. When people are equipped to think independently and learn continuously, they’re better able to solve problems—both personal and global.  

It’s not a quick fix, but I believe it’s a foundational change that could help many other positive changes follow.
